name: Audit your site's SEO and fix what matters first
why: A guided run of the audit-then-fix sequence in the technical-seo-audit skill: ranked audit, on-page fixes, new titles and tags, and schema markup.

name: Fix a drop in search traffic and check it recovers
why: Turns a Search Console export into the pages that lost clicks, a ranked fix list and a recovery report, matching the search-traffic-drop-diagnosis skill.

name: Search Console traffic drop diagnoser
why: A focused step for finding which pages lost clicks and the likely cause from one export.

name: Search Console quick-win finder
why: Finds pages in striking distance to push this month, the opportunity step of the monthly search review.

name: Monthly Search Console keeper
why: An agent that runs the monthly review loop: pages to push, thin pages to fix and next posts to write.

name: Plan a topic cluster from keywords to briefs and links
why: Goes from keyword research to a cluster plan, post briefs and internal links, the same path as the keyword-intent-map and seo-content-brief skills.

name: Write a post that beats the pages ranking today
why: Builds a brief from the pages that rank, then a full post and page fixes, for when the client wants the writing done too.

name: Find old posts losing traffic and refresh or cut them
why: The refresh, merge or cut decisions of the content-refresh-cycle workflow, with tracking.

name: Keyword to post outline writer
why: A quick one-page outline with intent and headings when a full brief is more than the job needs.

name: Search title and snippet writer
why: Writes titles and descriptions within length limits, a companion to the title-and-meta-rewrite prompt.

name: Customer question keyword finder
why: Pulls search questions from reviews, tickets and comments, the customer-language seed step of keyword research.

name: Store SEO fix prioritiser
why: Ranks crawl-report fixes for online shops by sales at risk, with an ignore list.

name: Store link gap planner
why: Finds earned-link targets against rivals and drafts pitch emails, for the link earning side of the role.

name: Domain and redirect layout planner
why: Plans the main address and redirects for several domains, useful at the start of a site migration.

name: SEO worth-it checker
why: Gives an honest go, go small or not-now call on SEO from margin, cash and hours, for clients who may not be ready.
